updated_for: Current DoED operating-register authority, pinned DoED-NAXA operating point crossmatch, top-ten project overlay, and Kali Gandaki A naming correction
research_boundary: Only source-backed geography and source-backed project reference points are shown. Project points are not treated as full project footprints. Screening candidates, hazard areas, infrastructure-proximity layers and environmental constraints remain absent until governed evidence or reproducible analysis outputs are admitted.
current_authority_context: The current DoED operating register used by this research system is dated 18 September 2026 and contains 217 operating hydropower projects. The point crossmatch is a separately pinned July 2026 reconciliation layer and must not be mistaken for a complete September operating register.
coordinate_rule: A map marker must describe what its coordinate actually represents. NAXA/local raw coordinates are project reference points unless a separate source explicitly identifies a powerhouse, dam, intake or other facility point.
kali_gandaki_correction: Kali Gandaki is the river/geographic name. Kali Gandaki A is a hydropower project/station. The highlighted 27.931, 83.6152 point is the powerhouse/generating-station point near Beltari/Yamgha, Syangja; the dam/headworks are upstream near Mirmi.

stored_registers.description: Governed September 18, 2026 DoED operating-register manifest: 217 operating entries, 211 with non-zero official geographic coordinate extents, and six zero-coordinate exclusions.
